verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state Stripe Issuing supports building 'a commercial or consumer card program' (stripe-issuing-docs-17) and cards are funded from a Stripe balance (stripe-issuing-docs-9), but there's no explicit documentation distinguishing true debit vs prepaid vs revolving-credit underwriting models, and a community comment raises the concern that Issuing cards may still show up as 'prepaid' to some merchants (stripe-issuing-comm-2), suggesting the rail is fundamentally balance/prepaid-based rather than offering distinct credit-line products. Missing for 10: explicit product docs differentiating debit/prepaid/credit card types and confirmation of revolving consumer/commercial credit underwriting, plus independent verification resolving the prepaid-classification concern.
